answer: Require each identity to post a distinct surety bond from a licensed surety, underwritten for that principal alone. The surety checks credit, demands collateral and an indemnity, and pays out on proven fraud, so it prices each risk separately and aggregates related applicants. One honest agent bridges onboarding once; a farm hits a reef when a thousand fakes each need fresh underwriting, premiums and locked collateral, and the bond ledger is a mirror no cloned history can fool.
